name: Fixture webhooks
description: Test fixture for plugin inbound webhooks: one webhook per verification scheme, a Slack challenge responder, a failing handler and a respond function that reaches for ctx, a counted challenge responder with a delivery id header, two names one extending the other, and a handler that leaks the body into its log and error.

webhooks.name: token
webhooks.description: Constant token header, as GitLab sends

webhooks.name: probe
webhooks.description: A respond function that reaches for ctx

webhooks.name: answered
webhooks.description: A counted challenge responder with a sender delivery id

webhooks.name: a
webhooks.description: A short name, for delivery id collisions

webhooks.name: a-b
webhooks.description: A name extending another, for delivery id collisions

webhooks.name: leaky
webhooks.description: A handler that logs and throws the request body
